programme.title: 西遊記之月光寶盒
programme.desc: 菩提老祖為了挽回自己的過失阻止兩人陰謀來到五嶽山，他說明至尊寶是孫悟空轉世，至尊寶不相信白骨精五百年前和孫悟空有一段糾纏不清的戀情，此時為了救至尊寶襲擊春三十娘，卻中毒受傷此時牛魔王殺到，二女不敵，挾持至尊寶和二當家逃回到盤絲洞春三十娘逼迫白晶晶殺掉至尊寶，卻反被二人關在機關春欲用迷情大法對付至尊寶，又錯用在二當家身上

programme.title: 冰封俠-時空行者
programme.desc: 描述從明朝將軍賀英（甄子丹飾）阿狗（王寶強飾）與聶虎（喻亢飾）來到現在香港，經歷青馬大橋之戰最終阿狗死去，而賀英與阿虎則被警方扣查，從明朝來到現代的副警務署張一鳴（任達華飾）帶走賀英與阿狗來到北京，希望藉賀英手上的時空金碟回到明朝，而在現代遇上賀英的酒吧女郎小美（黃聖依飾）亦一同回去三人回到明朝，回到一切發生的前夕而賀英選擇回到桃源村的道路，卻影響了他與其他相關人等的往後命運

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 一個鄉村里，遠隔幾十里路都沒有人，只住著兩戶人家，一位和尚，一位道士，和尚名叫一休大師，還有個女徒弟叫菁菁，道士名叫四目道長，還有個男徒弟叫家樂家樂一直深深喜歡菁菁，兩人經常互相逗笑和調情他們的師傅則是因為門戶之見和民族內訌性格而經常互相鬥法，最後雙方都兩敗俱傷

programme.title: 鬼咬鬼2
programme.desc: 肥寶一天做了個夢，夢裡他與父母生前為他指腹為婚的朱家大小姐朱女私奔，誤闖鬼屋，還被惡鬼追殺後被師父九叔拍醒一夜肥寶賣粥遇見女鬼小紅，他同情小紅身世淒涼，故收留小紅母女一人一鬼住進家中

programme.title: 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: 因緣際會，玄奘無意間解開了五行山下鎮壓孫悟空的佛印孫悟空受制於觀音菩薩所賜的金箍，應下保護唐僧西去的使命悟空雖然心中不服玄奘，但他一路上開山問路，收服八戒沙僧，倒也盡忠職守然而，頭頂的金箍與唐僧制約他的緊箍咒法卻始終困擾著他白虎嶺白骨夫人千年成精，必須服用玄奘金身方可擺脫妖物輪回大限白骨精洞悉孫悟空與唐僧之間的隔閡，故而三番兩次挑撥二人師徒關係孫悟空在背負屈辱之下，還要以武鬥以智取難奈玄奘凡胎肉眼，看不清白骨真身白骨詭計得逞，師徒二人就此決裂

programme.title: 臭屁王
programme.desc: 臭屁文家中雖然富有，但他的煩惱卻比別的小孩都多，因為他的爸爸要跟別人結婚了臭屁文在爸爸的婚禮上，捉弄得新媽媽衣不蔽體，也因此遭到父親嚴厲的處罰臭屁文決心離家出走，但頭一天就被小流氓洗劫一空幸好有達叔收留他，才不至於挨餓受凍

programme.title: 罪後真相
programme.desc: 以新聞名嘴劉立民作為全片視角，他在監獄採訪的過程中，被準備逃獄七年前涉嫌殺害女友的球星張正義狹持，成為全國新聞焦點過程中，他們逐步掀開隱藏在殺人案背後的重重內幕

programme.title: 黑社會
programme.desc: 和聯勝是香港最具江湖地位的社團，兩年一度的扛把子選舉，由阿樂與大D競爭所以雙方想盡辦法，各自拉攏江湖中擁有投票權的大哥級人物，選舉由阿樂勝出，大D不服，企圖搶奪和聯勝最高權力象徵的龍頭棍，以阻止阿樂登位

programme.title: 鬼咬鬼2
programme.desc: 肥寶一天做了個夢，夢裡他與父母生前為他指腹為婚的朱家大小姐朱女私奔，誤闖鬼屋，還被惡鬼追殺後被師父九叔拍醒一夜肥寶賣粥遇見女鬼小紅，他同情小紅身世淒涼，故收留小紅母女一人一鬼住進家中

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣:293
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的IPSS 的女王小S，睽違六年強勢回歸！ 以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 全民星攻略:293
programme.desc: 用智慧掌握機會才能創造獨一無二的命運 全民星攻略智慧星幣翻倍賽 不變的是廣度與深度的知識含量

programme.title: 今晚開讚吧:299
programme.desc: 結合不同族群社團粉絲團民調排行榜合作！ 利用大數據分析，反應市場趨勢，精準抓出熱門關注話題！

programme.title: 赤道
programme.desc: 國際頭號通緝犯赤盜從北韓偷取了濃縮鈾原料，準備在香港轉售中東恐怖組織事件引起中國香港韓國與美國各國高度重視，克服相互間的矛盾，聯手追捕最後，赤盜躲到澳門，正邪雙方展開決戰

programme.title: 至尊無上
programme.desc: 三人回香港後，宮木太郎為了報復，雇香港黑幫人士追殺羅森羅森得螃蟹相救逃過一劫，但是螃蟹的左手卻也因此受傷，影響了他賭技的發揮

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳
programme.desc: 1949年，潮州人雷洛，為了生計，投考香港警察訓練學校，在面試時他不太識字，甚至連報紙上徐蚌會戰的蚌與攻陷的陷都念不出來，但還是順利錄取了，於黃竹坑受訓半年後結訓，結訓時警校教官居然告訴他們，不一定要自命清高，要因時達變，雷洛對於這種同流合汙的貪腐思想相當不滿

programme.title: 逃學威龍
programme.desc: 周星星是皇家香港警察特別任務連某隊隊長，受上司委派假扮學生混入一間中學當臥底, 搜尋一支失槍的下落警隊同僚曹達華亦假扮工友潛伏在該校接應周星星其間周星星因受不了中學生活，在意圖逃學的過程中遇見了好心關心他的該校女教師何敏，周星星愛上何敏並因此發憤圖強用功讀書，兩人歷經種種誤會，周星星最後成功搗破了大飛的犯罪圖謀, 並抱得美人歸

programme.title: 賭霸
programme.desc: 元奎與劉鎮偉合導，劇情圍繞一場國際超級賭王大賽，二人為了脫穎而出，各施各法片中鄭裕玲由魚欄的賭桌贏到國際級賭術比賽，形象前後改變極大，魅力發放

programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 鍾馗誅妖傳
programme.desc: 唐朝時期妖怪肆虐，天神因而封印妖王沐風的妖力，使其無法作亂妖王的伴侶，千年花妖風四娘，為了解除封印，便到處尋找捉妖天師鍾馗的下落面對強妖來襲，鍾馗為了保護百姓，想出一招險記來對付風四娘

programme.title: 鬥陣來發財
programme.desc: 台灣有個樸素平凡的大寶村，村民們人人勤奮不已，生活簡單快樂有一天，剛死老公的風騷錢嫂開了一家樂透店，原本對樂透完全不感興趣的村民們，卻因為窮鬼來富中了一次四星，全村漸漸掀起買獎券的熱潮，更一窩峰的開始求明牌，各種花招不停出籠，陷入瘋狂即將結婚的年輕人小馬與朋友們也擋不住金錢的誘惑迷失了自己，差點就失去了人生最重要的的東西沒想到，在結婚典禮上，一張樂透獎券又即將引發另一場風暴

programme.title: 雙瞳
programme.desc: 台北，熱鬧繁華的都會大城，現代高科技生活與華人幾千年的傳統信念並存在這個冷漠異境的城市裡，人們相信鬼魂就像是高樓大廈般真實可及城市車水馬龍人群往來穿梭，一個身心受創的警官正和不知名的神秘惡魔搏鬥，受威脅的不只是他的性命，還包括他的靈魂警官黃火土（梁家輝飾）的世界正逐漸四分五裂兩年前由於揭發同僚貪污，黃火土被打入冷宮，被安排在冷門的外事組工作，他的同事對他怒言相向，他的妻子清芳（劉若英飾）受不了他長期不回家而要求離婚就在此刻，三宗離奇的命案卻使整個警局天搖地動三名受害者的身分彼此沒有關聯，但是前來驗屍的法醫（楊貴媚飾）卻在三名死者腦部共同發現一種神秘的黑黴菌，而且三人都是在歷經幻覺的狀態下死亡顯然這是連續殺人犯所為，且為台灣歷史上的頭一遭負責偵辦的警局又缺乏這方面的專才，在社會人心惶惶的氛圍下，高層只好求助於台灣最好的盟友美國美國聯邦調查局派了一名專門偵辦此種案例的專家

programme.title: 逆轉勝
programme.desc: 小香（黃姵嘉飾）是明星高中品學兼優的好學生，也是學校的儀隊隊長，青春無敵堅強不服輸但在父母相繼過世後，可觀的債務讓家裡經營的撞球館面臨倒閉命運不但引來社會局上門關切，強制介入安排寄養家庭，更有黑道討債集團威脅逼迫還款腹背受敵走投無路的小香只好與好友黑輪（劉以豪飾）商量，費盡千辛萬苦，找到十年前的一代撞球球王，卻因欠債跑路，至此人間蒸發的叔叔雙丰（溫尚翊飾）回來擔任監護人

programme.title: 師兄撞鬼
programme.desc: 幹探張標在偵查製毒機關時遭毒梟槍殺，死後在天堂法庭受審，法官准其回到凡間緝兇，更指點他尋找有梅花胎記之救星協助報仇張標尋得其救星乃乖巧滑頭學警阿星，逐暗中保護張標現身向阿星表明來意，令阿星又驚又喜，人鬼卒達成協議，張標負責幫阿星泡妞立功，阿星則助他尋兇報仇

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 九品後補知縣包龍星辦案能力不足，深受百姓唾棄此時戚家發生滅門慘案，倖存的戚秦氏指認常威為兇手，但常威之父水師提督常昆運用權勢誣陷戚秦氏為犯人，而星亦被調離此案當夜星與其侄有為回凶案現場找證據翻案，反而被打入大牢星逃獄後決心替戚秦氏洗刷冤屈，隨一雜技團上京告御狀

programme.title: 碧血劍:26
programme.desc: 夏雪宜?綽號金蛇郎君，全家被溫家堡之惡人慘殺，誓要報仇遇上溫儀後被儀的純真與善良打動，結成愛侶可惜溫儀被溫家堡利用，令雪宜身中劇毒及被挑斷手筋腳筋，儀欲將溫家惡行公開而遭活埋井下亡在生死關頭，雪宜被何紅藥救走並逼婚，結果被打斷雙腳，秘密囚於五毒教的靈蛇洞內 袁承誌?袁崇煥之子，立誌長大後保衛國家父被曹化淳誣害慘死，並誅連九族，承誌被夏雪宜所救，隨後在華山學藝，誓報父仇

programme.title: 山忌-黃衣小飛俠

programme.title: 佛跳牆
programme.desc: 李翰祥執導的佛跳牆共有四個單元，首個故事是描述一對母子因施予濟公一碗豆漿而逃過喪命之危；其二則說濟公幫助賣菜漢，逃離高利貸者的滋擾；其三則寫濟公以櫻桃化夜明珠，將大盜教訓一頓；最末一則是描寫濟公以巧計捉弄胡作非為的相爺父子李翰祥借濟公的善行，針貶權貴惡霸的種種惡行，為平民大眾吐一口烏氣

programme.title: 一眉道人

programme.title: 新兵正傳
programme.desc: 含著金湯匙出生的Ken 陳偉恩 飾，從小受媽媽和奶奶的溺愛，高中畢業後隨即面臨新加坡兵役通知，恨透當兵的他因此大吵大鬧，心疼不已的媽媽決定協助兒子延遲兵役，用盡各種方式，卻徒勞無功 不情不願進入部隊的Ken認識了好動又愛吹牛的鬼點子王羅邦王偉良 飾求好表現討好長官的Waylang林俊良 飾以及樣貌奇特的IP man葉榮耀 飾等人Kan和羅邦兩人有志一同，整天花樣百出閃避操練 厭惡在軍營中的生活的他，又發現女友移情別戀，急於挽回女友的他竟決定要用生病來逃離軍營，努力虐待自己的Ken終於病倒，急忙趕往醫院的爸爸途中卻因心臟病發而發生了車禍

programme.title: 賭神
programme.desc: 賭神高進受日本山口組的上山委託來港與殺父仇人賭魔鮑漢林決戰進看出主事人南哥等人出千，出手反千贏回大量巨款而去南哥不憤指使越南殺手追殺進上山先生委派龍五保護進火拼中，進頭部受重傷不支倒地記憶全失，被刀仔及其女友收留賭摩之助手南哥得知進等藏身於銷魂別墅即派數拾殺手追殺，追殺期間進漸回復記憶，再和賭摩在牌上決戰一場

programme.desc: 當紐奧良的警探在一輛汽車的後車廂裡發現一具被燒焦的女性屍體時，他們很快發現一件令人震驚的事：她在生前曾經絕望地撥打911求救，但那通求救電話卻沒有得到任何及時的回應

programme.title: 黃金48小時第26季:518
programme.desc: 在塔爾薩，探員全城追捕一名在逃男子，同時要查明一名女子身上離奇傷勢背後的真相

programme.title: 與殺手共眠第2季:3
programme.desc: 一名女子撥打九一一，通報自己是在自我防衛的情況下開槍射殺男友然而，調查人員抵達後，卻發現案發現場異常整潔，幾乎毫無混亂跡象，再加上她表現出的某些令人不安的行為，使她的說法開始受到嚴重質疑

programme.title: 頭條新聞之外:5

programme.title: 頭條新聞之外:6

programme.title: 被告-是我所為？:10

programme.title: 儲物狂第14季:7

programme.title: 出庭作證第4季:6

programme.title: 偵訊實境第2季:9

programme.desc: 香港法證部高級化驗師高安法醫科高級醫生聞家希西九龍重案組高級督察郭輝煌，這滅罪鐵三角帶領著精英團隊，用專業的法證科學，揭示驚人的預謀策劃；用精密的法醫知識，破解隱蔽的人體密碼；用嚴謹的執法精神，披露震撼的罪惡真相！熱血記者徐意，童年憾事竟與高安緊扣牽連；法證專才水慧明，遭至愛背叛頓成殺人疑兇

programme.title: 機場特警
programme.desc: 香港警務處機場特警組（ASU）是一支準軍事化特種警察部隊，責任是維持機場警區的公共及航空安全反恐要員保護及災難支援等等故事由一宗機場劫案引發，一名疑犯逃走引發一宗嚴重交通意外，休班警員張景山（張振朗飾）章振赫（黃子恆飾）及辛凱晴（蔡思貝飾）剛好來到機場，參與現場救人及捉拿疑犯的行動

programme.title: 天天天晴
programme.desc: 龍福是本地名門石敢當集團旗下的珠寶店，在老闆娘明心安領導下，經歷九七回歸亞洲金融風暴沙士和金融海嘯等大大小小風波，由瀕臨結業至成為數一數二的珠寶店品牌精明的心深受店內員工及同行敬重，令人艷羨雖然風光背後事業和家庭各有隱憂，但樂觀的她積極面對，充滿正能量

programme.desc: 龍福是本地名門石敢當集團旗下的珠寶店，在老闆娘明心安領導下，經歷九七回歸亞洲金融風暴沙士和金融海嘯等大大小小風波，由瀕臨結業至成為數一數二的珠寶店品牌精明的心深受店內員工及同行敬重，令人艷羨雖然風光背後事業和家庭各有隱憂，但樂觀的她積極面對，充滿正能量

programme.title: 金宵大廈
programme.desc: 蕭偉明（陳山聰飾）來到殘舊且品流複雜的金宵大廈當看更，遇上這裡的空姐住客Alex（李施嬅飾）容貌竟與夢中一直纏繞自己的旗袍女子相同！阿蕭接近Alex，瞭解更多彼此的關聯其間金宵大廈怪事不斷，不停上演著其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿蕭更發現Alex竟是一個殘影！

programme.title: 法證先鋒4
programme.desc: 香港法證部高級化驗師高安法醫科高級醫生聞家希西九龍重案組高級督察郭輝煌，這滅罪鐵三角帶領著精英團隊，用專業的法證科學，揭示驚人的預謀策劃；用精密的法醫知識，破解隱蔽的人體密碼；用嚴謹的執法精神，披露震撼的罪惡真相！熱血記者徐意，童年憾事竟與高安緊扣牽連；法證專才水慧明，遭至愛背叛頓成殺人疑兇

programme.title: 神鵰俠侶1983年
programme.desc: 郭靖（梁家仁飾）與黃蓉（歐陽佩珊飾）一家卻在桃花島上過著寧靜的生活及後，為了尋訪黃藥師（曾江飾）而重返中原，巧遇楊康之子楊過（劉德華飾），郭靖見他年幼乏人照顧，把他帶回桃花島撫養後因楊過個性頑劣，郭靖決定送他到重陽宮拜師學武

programme.desc: 台灣百廟帶您悠遊台灣各處宮廟，發現最在地的民間故事，品嚐最道地的庶民小吃，體驗最特別的民俗風情，探索最深植人心的宮廟文化給您最不同以往的行腳文化之旅

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: 城中之城

programme.title: The Empress Dowager ((太后有喜))

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow ((徐老虎与白寡妇))
programme.desc: A woman gets involved in a Ching Dynasty salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and dilemmas gone rotten. (一位妇女卷入了清朝的盐贩运圈子, 臭着失踪的人,)

programme.title: The Singing Killer ((小煞星))

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities ((港澳传奇))
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang directs this fascinating comedy about three couples and forbidden love across Macau and Hong Kong. (李汉导演了这部关于三对夫妇和禁止爱情的迷人喜剧.)

programme.desc: A legendary treasure hidden in Seouls royal tomb sparks fierce rivalry as the exacavators and others with secret agendas race to outwit each other for the kings relics. Who will prevail? (首尔王室墓藏的传奇宝藏引发了激烈的争斗,就像挖掘者和其他有着秘密议程的人竞相为国王的遗迹相互逃避。 谁能获胜呢?)

programme.title: Sisters on the Road ((现在这样就好))
programme.desc: After her mothers death, Myung-eun meets her sister Myung-ju. They do not share the same father and decided to travel together to find Myung-euns father. A secret of her father reveals... (去世后,遇到了妹妹,他们没有同一个父亲,他们决定一起去寻找的父亲.)

programme.title: Once We Were Us ((後來的我們))
programme.desc: Former lovers Eun-ho and Jeong-won unexpectedly reunite on a flight to Korea, giving them a second chance to reminisce about their past and share long-buried words with each other. (让他们有第二次机会回想起自己的过去, 并彼此分享长久的言辞。)

programme.title: Joseon Chefs ((需云杂方))
programme.desc: A nobleman who has passed the national civil service exam meets the self-proclaimed best chef in Joseon, falls into the world of gourmet food, and sets out to find the life he truly wants. (一位通过国家公务员考试的贵族遇到了自称为子最好的厨师,)

programme.title: Miracle in Cell No.7 ((七号房的礼物 2))
programme.desc: A mentally challenged father whos wrongly jailed for the murder of a young girl reunites with his young daughter in the prison. (一位因杀害一个年轻女孩被错误地监禁的精神障碍父亲在监狱里与他的小女儿重聚.)

programme.title: The Unfair ((马尔科姆的一家：生活依旧不公))
programme.desc: A protest against urban renewal leads to death of a cop and a teen. The boys father was arrested for the cops death. A young attorney is assigned to defend the father. (抗议城市更新导致一名警察和一名青少年死亡.男孩的父亲被捕为警察的死亡.一名年轻的律师被任命为捍卫父亲.)

programme.title: Split ((分道扬镳))
programme.desc: Cheol-jong was once a legendary bowler, but an accident ended his career. He later teams up with an autistic genius bowling player Young-hoon and bookmaker Hee-jin to make money.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere (无处可见的人)
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hope of saving the child who is his only friend. (一个有暴力的过去的安静的质押店员, 面对了一家贩毒网络, 希望能拯救他唯一的朋友的孩子.)

programme.title: Dark Nuns ((黑修女们))
programme.desc: A boy is possessed by an evil spirit and his life is at risk. 2 nuns embark on a dangerous ritual and are determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. (两个修女开始一个危险的仪式,决心以任何代价拯救男孩,不管风险或后果如何.)

programme.title: The Whistleblower ((告密者))
programme.desc: A disgraced Korean researcher claims to have successfully cloned human embryo stem cells. However, the results were revealed to be fabricated along with other unethical practices later. (韩国一名尬的研究人员声称成功克隆了人类胚胎干细胞.)

programme.title: The Priests (祭司们)
programme.desc: After a girl is assaulted, two priests must determine if she was attacked by an evil spirit or a molester. (两个祭司要确定一个女孩被邪灵攻击了还是被强奸者攻击了.)

programme.title: Hear Me: Our Summer ((听说))
programme.desc: Yong-jun is working as a delivery man when he meets and instantly falls for Yeo-reum, the devoted sister of a gifted deaf swimmer. Yeo-reum slowly opens her heart to warm-hearted Yong-jun. (俊当遇到姆时,他就在做分发员,他立刻爱上了姆,一位有才华的聋游泳者的忠诚妹妹.)

programme.title: Gyeong-ahs Daughter ((景雅的女儿))
programme.desc: After her husband passed away, Gyeong-ah relies on her daughter Yeon-su. But they barely meet each other. One day, Gyeong-ah gets an anonymous message about Yeon-su and goes into trauma... (丈夫去世后,依赖她的女儿苏,但他们几乎没有见面.)

programme.title: The Favor ((相伴到永远))
programme.desc: A familys prayers are answered by a mysterious savior, but as miracles spread, they uncover a chilling truth: every gift comes with a deadly curse. (一个家庭的祈祷被一个神秘的救主回答,)

programme.title: Love Clinique ((音痴诊所))
programme.desc: Dong-ju joins school choir for Min-soo even she is tone-deaf. They reunite 10 years later. She wants to impress him so she enrolls in a vocal training clinic where Shin-hong trains her... (东加入了明的学校合唱团,即使她是听不懂的,他们10年后再聚在一起,她想给他留下深刻的印象,所以她就进入了声学训练诊所,)

programme.desc: Jun is serializing a new season of webtoon. He receives an e-mail with great storyline thus draws according to it. Terrorism similar to the story occurs and Jun is being suspected... (正在编辑一个新的网络漫画季节. 他收到一个电子邮件,故事情节很好,因此根据它绘制.)

Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolins Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hungs son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Fengs innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader Yama Teng Wei-hao to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan Chen Hung and Pai Pan Hung Hsin-nan to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei Pai Piao...

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gamblers apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liangs masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Gamblers Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan heads son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the familys fortune.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lians affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: When the billionaire father-in-law of veteran homicide detective Hei is brutally murdered, Heis wife, doubting the police investigation, hires his former partner and close friend, private detective Bong, to uncover the truth. As the case takes unexpected twists, Bong discovers the murder is mysteriously linked to Hei.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggars gang when he saves the gangs elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Final Justice 1988
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Taos house became haunted. Years later, Master Taos descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: Its an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wifes rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. Its one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs III
programme.desc: Ming is transferred to do menial police work ten months after the murder of Yan, in 2004. Meanwhile, a new star, Wing, has emerged in the police force and Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad. Determined to start anew, Ming must kill Wing while ensuring his own identity does not get exposed.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Clouds successor as the citys guard.

programme.title: The Sorcerer The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snakes true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandoras box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandoras Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.desc: 本该在野外探勘的地质学博士苏纪时，因为双胞胎妹妹苏瑾不辞而别引发的职业危机，暂时回来顶替妹妹上岗成为艺人苏瑾先前和穆氏集团总裁穆休伦有情侣合约的协议，苏纪时在忙着提防身份被揭穿的同时，还需履行与穆休伦的假情侣合约，两人在情感中你来我往，暧昧上头.

programme.desc: Li Yifei tutors Qian Fei and grows jealous of her blind date, rescuing her when it turns unsafe. Dang Yu rejects pressure from Dajuns mother, worsening the mother-son conflict.

programme.title: 正义女神 Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 天龙八部 Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: 金庸先生為大家創造了一個波瀾壯闊的武俠世界，天龍八部更是金庸小說系列中最受讀者喜愛及追捧的巔峰之作之一，它的經典程度不言而喻，也是長盛不衰的改編題材nn故事以北宋哲宗時代為背景，通過丐幫幫主喬峰楊祐寧飾大理世子段譽白澍飾少林小僧虛竹張天陽飾三人的江湖歷險與愛恨情仇，以及圍繞在他們周圍的一眾江湖人物，展現了紛繁複雜的武林恩怨和無計可消除的貪嗔癡怨，勾勒了一幅充滿人情世態的生活畫卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸眾生，皆逃不出情這一字帶來的痛苦糾纏.

programme.desc: 金庸先生為大家創造了一個波瀾壯闊的武俠世界，天龍八部更是金庸小說系列中最受讀者喜愛及追捧的巔峰之作之一，它的經典程度不言而喻，也是長盛不衰的改編題材nn故事以北宋哲宗時代為背景，通過丐幫幫主喬峰楊祐寧飾大理世子段譽白澍飾少林小僧虛竹張天陽飾三人的江湖歷險與愛恨情仇，以及圍繞在他們周圍的一眾江湖人物，展現了紛繁複雜的武林恩怨和無計可消除的貪嗔癡怨，勾勒了一幅充滿人情世態的生活畫卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸眾生，皆逃不出情這一字帶來的痛苦糾纏.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Untuk episod kali ini, mereka akan pergi ke 54200 Breakfast, Restoran Kung Fu Ramen dan Rollo Mexican Food.

programme.title: EKSPRESI FESYEN
programme.desc: Aliya Marissa akan berbual fesyen bersama pengasas jenama Dia Guild. Untuk segmen GRWM get ready with me, penonton akan mendapat idea untuk bergaya bersama tetamu jemputan, Faruq Suhaimi yang merupakan seorang penari professional dan koreografer.

programme.title: DAPUR BUJANG
programme.desc: Jom ikuti Chef Naem yang akan berkongsi 2 resipi istimewa yang tersangat mudah, lazat, dan pastinya membangkitkan selera anda! Menu kali ini adalah Pasta Goreng Kampung Sup Wantan.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Segala usaha semata untuk mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah telah dilakukan oleh Iskandar termasuk kembali ke kampong halaman Aisyah dan bertemu dengan Mak Su Ainin. Iskandar juga melakonkan semula episode hitam di mana dia dan Aisyah di tangkap khalwat dan dipaksa untuk berkahwin. Namun semua itu adalah usaha yang sia-sia. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha gembira melihat keadaan Aisyah yang sudah hilang ingatan. Mereka semakin yakin segala harta milik arwah Puan Ainon dan Encik Latiff akan jatuh ke tangan mereka. Farid pula bersenang lenang dan yakin pada malam dia mahu merogol Aisyah tidak akan diingati oleh Aisyah. Sangkaan Farid meleset apabila saat Aisyah melihat wajah Farid dia ketakutan dan mahu melindunginya sendiri. Iskandar buntu bagaimana lagi cara untuk dia mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah sehingga dia berjumpa dengan Ros di sebuah gerai. Ros tidak dapat menahan perasaannya apabila Aisyah juga tidak mampu mengingingatinya. Ros mengajak Iskandar untuk menziarahi kubur kedua ibu bapa Aisyah kerana di situ lah tempat yang wajib untuk Aisyah pergi sebelum dia berkahwin dengan Iskandar. Di kubur, Aisyah menangis. Iskandar mula gembira dan menyangkakan ingatan Aisyah akan pulih.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Keadaan Talia semakin tenat. Segalanya dibantu oleh Antasya dan Syarfan. Hubungan Aiia dan Nazarin juga semakin rapat. Nazarin sering mencuri pandang ke arah Alia. Gadis itu istimewa baginya. Najwan masih menahan diri dari terus menyukai Syafinaz dan terus menjauh sebaik sahaja dia selesai bertugas. Syarfan cuba mencuri masa bagi membawa Antasya berehat dan membeli barangan bagi menyambut bayi mereka.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Jazlan dan Qasih selamat melangsungkan pernikahan mereka dan masuk ke dalam bilik Jazlan cuba untuk bersyarah mengenai hukum hakam agama yang Qasih perlu lakukan tetapi Qasih terlebih dahulu menyuarakan kehendak beliau dan syarat-syarat beliau di dalam perkahwinan mereka. Selepas balik dari rumah mama Qasih, Jazlan mengarahkan Qasih untuk menutup aurat dan memakai tudung. Beberapa hari kemudian Jazlan membawa Qasih balik ke Madinah. Jazlan dan Qasih mula menjalani hidup mereka sebagai suami isteri, dengan Jazlan sentiasa menitikberatkan tanggungjawab kepada agama dan tanggungjawab isteri terhadap suami

programme.title: Concert Dia.. Lagenda Unplugged Salimah Mahmood
programme.desc: Dalam rancangan ini, Salimah Mahmood berkongsi pelbagai cerita permulaan penglibatannya di dalam dunia seni nyanyian.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah tidak mampu lagi memaafkan Lukman apabila sekali lagi bertembung dengan Myra di dalam rumah Lukman. Seluruh kepercayaan sudah lerai. Dia keluar dari rumah dan enggan berjumpa dengan Lukman lagi. Dia sanggup tinggal di hotel demi menjauhkan diri daripada semua orang. Lukman resah apabila tidak dapat mencari Farah namun hal itu disembunyikan daripada familinya. Segalanya berpunca daripada Myra yang datang ke rumah demi mengadukan konon dirinya teraniaya. Pihak pengurusan syarikat mendapat bukti bahawa Lukman terbabit dalam kehilangan wang syarikat. Abah tidak percaya dengan tindakan Farah yang nekad ke UK meninggalkan suami dan Zahin. Budi mengesyaki ada yang tak kena dengan kes Lukman. Farah pula menanggalkan cincin perkahwinan lalu diserahkan kepada Lukman. Dia sudah redha apa sahaja jalinan takdirnya. Lukman ditahan polis untuk siasatan kes pecah amanah.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Qasih menyahut cabaran untuk menjadi isteri yang solehah dengan mengemas rumah dan memasak untuk suaminya. Jazlan pula merasakan yang beliau gagal menjadi seorang suami yang baik kerana tidak dapat membentuk isterinya menjadi isteri yang solehah. Masakan yang dimasak Qasih melalui youtube menyebabkan Jazlan bangun di tengah malam dan bergegas ke bilik air, keesokannya Jazlan sakit kepala dan demam. Salah seorang pelajar Arab yang dibimbing Jazlan menghantarkan nasi arab ke rumah yang membuatkan Qasih cemburu dan sakit hati kerana beliau telah mula mencintai Jazlan. Setelah keadaan sebenarnya diterangkan Qasih dan Jazlan mula bermesra dan bergurau senda menjalani kehidupan sebagai suami isteri dengan penuh bahagia

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Talia meniti saat akhirnya. Dia mengucapkan terima kasih dan meminta maaf atas perlakuannya. Syarfan turut memohon maaf atas sikap ibunya. Talia menghembuskan nafas terakhir di pangkuan Antasya. Syarfan sering pulang awal untuk menjaga Antasya kerana tarikh melahirkan bayi semakin hampir. Antasya bahagia.

programme.title: Mr. Mrs Cruz
programme.desc: Kisah ini memfokuskan kepada Raffy dan Gela yang bertemu ketika bercuti di El Nido, Palawan, lalu mengharungi cabaran serta dilema dalam memahami erti komitmen dalam hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah dapat merasakan kubur itu adalah sesuatu yang sangat bermakna dalam hidupnya. Perasaan dia menjadi sebak dan tak mampu di bendung lagi. Aisyah memohon maaf kepada Ros kerana tidak dapat mengingati siapa Ros tetapi dia dapat rasakan Ros juga merupakan seseorang yang bermakna dalam hidupnya. Kepulangan Aisyah dan Iskandar ke Kuala Lumpur mengejutkan mereka dengan persediaan majlis persandingan yang dilakukan oleh Tengku Maria dan Tengku Yusuf. Aisyah membantah hal itu dan meminta majlis itu tidak di teruskan. Iskandar cuba memujuk Aisyah dan berjanji akan membawa keluarga baharu Aisyah untuk meraikan mereka bersama. Aisyah bersetuju tetapi dia memberi syarat kepada Iskandar untuk memberinya keizinan supaya dia dapat pulang ke kampong halaman seorang diri untuk menjemput keluarga Mak Su Ainin dan Ros. Berat untuk Iskandar lepaskan kerana dia tahu akan bahayanya Aisyah jika dia kembali ke rumah Mak Su Ainin. Namun ketegasan Aisyah untuk membatalkan majlis persandingan itu jika Iskandar tidak memberi keizinan membuatkan Iskandar terpaksa akur. Iskandar mengekori Aisyah tanpa pengetahuan Aisyah. Di kampong, Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha mengambil kesempatan terhadap Aisyah. Niat baik Aisyah untuk menjemput mereka turut serta membuahkan bermacam penghinaan terhadap diri Aisyah sehingga Aisyah jatuh sakit. Ros adalah orang yang menyelamatkan Aisyah dan terpaksa menghubungi Iskandar bagi memaklumkan hal itu.

programme.desc: Aisyah dapat merasakan kubur itu adalah sesuatu yang sangat bermakna dalam hidupnya. Perasaan dia menjadi sebak dan tak mampu di bendung lagi. Kepulangan Aisyah dan Iskandar ke Kuala Lumpur mengejutkan mereka dengan persediaan majlis persandingan yang dilakukan oleh Tengku Maria dan Tengku Yusuf. Aisyah membantah hal itu dan meminta majlis itu tidak di teruskan. Iskandar cuba memujuk Aisyah dan berjanji akan membawa keluarga baharu Aisyah untuk meraikan mereka bersama. Aisyah bersetuju tetapi dia memberi syarat kepada Iskandar untuk memberinya keizinan supaya dia dapat pulang ke kampong halaman seorang diri untuk menjemput keluarga Mak Su Ainin dan Ros. Berat untuk Iskandar lepaskan kerana dia tahu akan bahayanya Aisyah jika dia kembali ke rumah Mak Su Ainin. Namun ketegasan Aisyah untuk membatalkan majlis persandingan itu jika Iskandar tidak memberi keizinan membuatkan Iskandar terpaksa akur. Iskandar mengekori Aisyah tanpa pengetahuan Aisyah. Di kampong, Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha mengambil kesempatan terhadap Aisyah. Niat baik Aisyah untuk menjemput mereka turut serta membuahkan bermacam penghinaan terhadap diri Aisyah sehingga Aisyah jatuh sakit. Ros adalah orang yang menyelamatkan Aisyah dan terpaksa menghubungi Iskandar bagi memaklumkan hal itu.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah tidak mampu lagi memaafkan Lukman apabila sekali lagi bertembung dengan Myra di dalam rumah Lukman. Seluruh kepercayaan sudah lerai. Dia keluar dari rumah dan enggan berjumpa dengan Lukman lagi. Dia sanggup tinggal di hotel demi menjauhkan diri daripada semua orang. Lukman resah apabila tidak dapat mencari Farah namun hal itu disembunyikan daripada familinya. Segalanya berpunca daripada Myra yang datang ke rumah demi mengadukan konon dirinya teraniaya. Pihak pengurusan syarikat mendapat bukti bahawa Lukman terbabit dalam kehilangan wang syarikat. Abah tidak percaya dengan tindakan Farah yang nekad ke UK meninggalkan suami dan Zahin. Budi mengesyaki ada yang tak kena dengan kes Lukman. Farah pula menanggalkan cincin perkahwinan lalu diserahkan kepada Lukman. Dia sudah redha apa sahaja jalinan takdirnya. Lukman ditahan polis untuk siasatan kes pecah amanah.

programme.title: Ronda Roda
programme.desc: Ronda Roda kali ini, menampilkan kereta Chery, Tp Autoworks dan Cefiro. Yang dihoskan oleh Mira Rizam dengan mempamerkan kereta baru dari Chery Omoda 5 dan hasil tangan dari Fazreen along dan Syuk.

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Ayam Kicap Pedas Piza Pratta sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Fahimi Rahmat.

programme.title: Rojak
programme.desc: Dihoskan oleh Leaism, beliau akan melakukan aktiviti yang tidak pernah beliau cuba, mencuba makanan baharu, dan berkongsi pengetahuan am. Selain itu, terdapat juga segmen melibatkan respondan luar iaitu Cabaran dan juga Soalan Rawak.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Dua minggu sebelum majlis dan impian perkahwinan Deanna semakin pudar. Adakah kisah dongeng Deanna akan berakhir dengan kekecewaan?

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Sepanjang berada di UK, Farah diasak rindu terhadap Lukman dan Zahin. Dia sibukkan diri dengan studi demi melupakan segala kemelut yang melanda di samping menjaga kandungannya yang makin membesar. Farah tidak tahu bahawa Lukman ditahan di lokap. Berita kematian Mama akibat heart attack bukan sahaja merentap jiwanya, malah meragut seluruh kebahagiaan keluarga. Lukman dihambat penyesalan tak berkesudahan. Zulkarnain ikat jamin dan menyelesaikan segala tuntutan syarikat untuk membebaskan Lukman. Liza dan Nazim seumpama tulang belakang yang sentiasa menyokong Farah di Manchester. Farah terkejut apabila Lukman tiba-tiba muncul di depan pintu apartment untuk memohon maaf kepadanya. Farah tidak sanggup berdepan dengan Lukman hingga menyebabkan mereka bertengkar. Tanpa sengaja, Farah tergelincir dan terjatuh di tangga hingga mengalami pendarahan.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Police Story
programme.desc: Seorang pegawai polis Hong Kong yang berintegriti perlu membersihkan nama baiknya apabila ketua sindiket dadah yang diburunya memerangkapnya atas tuduhan membunuh seorang anggota polis yang korup.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Dont Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Mummy Reborn
programme.desc: Apabila sekumpulan remaja dalam kemusnahan kewangan memutuskan untuk merompak kedai antik tempatan, mereka menemui sebuah kubur kayu lama yang mengandungi mayat Mumia dan azimat purba. Tetapi apa yang mereka tidak sedar adalah kubur ini terkutuk, dan apabila azimat itu dipisahkan daripada tuannya, dia akan melakukan apa sahaja untuk mendapatkannya kembali. Pencuri kita mesti menyelamatkan hari ini dan mengembalikan Mumia ke kuburnya sebelum terlambat untuk menyelamatkan dunia.

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langityang mampu mengawal minda manusiaenam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: The Swindlers
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penipu bersatu untuk memburu penipu terkenal yang diketahui mati, di tengah-tengah motif tersembunyi dan penipuan mereka.

programme.title: Black S2 EP6
programme.desc: Black berdepan dengan kes yang paling menggentarkan apabila emosinya terganggu buat pertama kali - seluruh skuad keluar mencari Bagas, yang juga dikenali sebagai Lelaki Berparut Cangkuk yang telah menahan dua orang tebusan, yang nampaknya cedera. Borhan bersemuka dengan Rahman tentang kaitannya dengan penipuan insurans yang ada hubungan dengan Lelaki Berparut Cangkuk. Akhirnya, pertembungan yang tegang dikhuatiri akan meragut nyawa orang yang tidak bersalah.

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang Fahmi Johan Asari yang amat mencintai isterinya Riana Aishah Ilias dan dia tidak dapat menerima kenyataan bahawa isterinya sudah meninggal dunia. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.desc: McCall bergegas mencari Dante apabila dia diculik oleh sepasang anggota polis yang panik yang takut akan tindakan balas, selepas mereka menahan Dante tanpa sebab dan menggunakan kekerasan yang berlebihan sebelum menyedari bahawa dia seorang rakan polis.

programme.title: Volkswagen Kuning
programme.desc: Filem ini diilhamkan oleh legenda urban terkenal Malaysia mengenai sebuah Volkswagen berwarna kuning yang misteri yang dilihat di Lebuhraya Karak. programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping ((港女野人))
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope.

programme.title: Imprisoned 2: There Is No Escape From Fate ((劫数难逃))
programme.desc: Hong Kong businessman Yu and his secretary travel abroad for business meetings. When the secretary is killed in their hotel, Yu is arrested. Despite pleading not guilty, Yu is imprisoned in a cruel multinational prison where the warden enjoys torturing prisoners, and he must find a way to escape from this dark and deadly prison to survive.

programme.title: Midnight Fly (午夜飞行)
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husbands mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price (米歇尔在危机中的婚姻中,在危机中的婚姻中,米歇尔出发前往欧洲度假,会见了一位名叫美木的日本妇女。 当她们成为朋友和一起旅行时,米歇尔发现美木是她的丈夫情妇。 当美木在摩洛哥失踪时,米雪会竭尽所能找到她,但最后却付出了沉重的代价。)

programme.title: Demi-Haunted ((魂魄唔齐))
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Feis ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish (Wan Fei是一位有前途的中国歌剧歌手,他暗中爱上了一位名叫江峰的人。她想为他唱歌,但死于一场悲剧性事故。 几年后,Wan Feis的鬼魂回来了,发现她的精神的一部分已经以中国年轻歌剧歌手Chor Bai的形式转世。 这终于让Wan Fei实现了她的愿望。)

programme.title: Untouchable ((不可侵犯))
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake. (菲成为澳门巨人黄的右手,他的手深处涉及合法和非法业务.然而,面临地下暴力,权力斗争和道德困境,菲被爱与正义之间撕裂.很快,他发现自己陷入了致命的博中,他的生命在危险中.)

programme.title: Behind the Shadows ((阴守忍者))
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wifes betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken. (欧阳二等兵侦探在调查期间发现了妻子的背叛。他因惊吓而放弃了一个失踪人员案件。不久之后,失踪的人就死了。陈督察怀疑一个连环杀手可能逍遥法外。 欧阳必须用他的能力在另一个人被杀死之前阻止凶手。)

programme.title: Mr Mrs Incredible ((神奇侠侣))
programme.desc: Middle-aged and retired superhero couple, Huan Gazer Man and Red Aroma Woman, settles into a contented life in a remote village. They find it hard to contain their powers though, and are bored by the uneventful life. When they hear a world martial arts contest is to be held in their village, both are itching to make their long-awaited comeback! (中年和退休的超级英雄夫妇Huan Gazer Man 和Red Aroma Women在偏远的村庄安顿下来,他们发现很难控制自己的力量,对平庸的生活感到无聊。 当他们听到世界武术比赛将在他们的村庄举行的时候,他们都渴望能够回到他们期待已久的回归!)

programme.title: Silent Code ((沉默代码~监狱的密约~ - 百度百科))
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem... (兰记者的任务是研究互联网新闻, 并穿越BBS热门论坛,梦想董事会。论坛创始人项项为网民分享梦想和想法创造了空间, 但最终却因视频泄露而成为激烈辩论的主题。 兰记者为真相挖掘真相时, 她发现事情比看上去复杂得多。)

programme.title: Endless Battle (无止境的战斗)
programme.desc: This is a story about two brothers. The younger brother is a drug lord while the elder brother Zhong is a police officer in the Narcotics Bureau. Both are involved in a drug cartels turf battle and during an escort mission, Zhong discovers his brothers hidden identity. This leads to an endless battle between good and evil.

programme.title: I Want to be Rich ((做个有钱人))
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estatea testament that perseverance pays off. (年轻的华人从贫困背景中崛起,背负着照顾其赌博父母和年幼的兄弟姐妹的沉重负担。 面对种种困难,他为家人提供更好生活的韧力和决心最终使他在房地产方面取得巨大成功,证明坚持不懈的精神是值得的。)

programme.title: Caught In Time ((除暴·独家纪录片))
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo ((山忌：黄衣小飞侠))
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: The Exodus ((苍穹之法芙娜 EXODUS))
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men. (一个低级警察发现了一群妇女,包括他的上司方方女士和妻子,密谋消灭男人的世界。)

programme.title: Back Home ((七月返归))
programme.desc: Wing has been able to see ghosts since young. When his mothers suicide attempt forces him to return to Hong Kong and the home he ran away from, he discovers that the horrific visions that once haunted him have become worse. Caught between the living and the dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free. (翼从小就能看到鬼魂。 当他的母亲自杀试图迫使他回到香港和他逃离的家时,他发现曾经困扰他的可怕幻觉已经变得更糟了。 翼在生死之间被困住,必须让真理被揭晓才能自由。)

programme.title: American Girl ((中文))
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003, when her mother is diagnosed with breast cancer. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father, and drifts away from her mother. When her younger sister is misdiagnosed with SARS, they finally open up to each other during quarantine.

programme.title: Call Me Agent ((我要做特務))
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult ((失衡凶间之恶念之最))
programme.desc: The movie consists of three tales about the horrors lurking in dark corners of the city. A young pop star goes back into depression when spooky things happen in her new home an online influencer performs live in a mall, but it ends up being a livestream of his death the residents of a tenement building battle a mysterious figure in the stairwell.

programme.title: Measure in Love ((他年她日))
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate. (一场大地震将世界分裂为两个时间以不同速度流动的区域。 在医疗救援任务中,安青学生与舒宰会面,并开始与众不同寻常的纽带。 然而,每次重聚,他都会在她没有变化的情况下迅速衰老,迫使他们面对时间、距离和命运挑战的爱情。)

programme.title: Burning Blood ((热血燃烧))
programme.desc: After a corrupt cop leaks their operation, four elite narcotics officers are ambushed while pursuing a cross-border drug lord. One is killed, their leader dies in the line of duty, and another vanishes without a trace. Years later, the surviving Chan Tai Wah and Low Mai reunite to expose the long-hidden mole and avenge their fallen comrades.

programme.title: Soul Mate ((灵魂伴侣))
programme.desc: July and An Sheng have been best friends since they were thirteen. They always believed their friendship would last forever, until they meet Su Jia Ming at the age of eighteen. The trio find themselves in a love triangle, which puts the girls friendship to the test and alters their destinies. (7月和安盛自13岁起就一直是最好的朋友。 他们一直相信友谊将永远持续下去,直到他们18岁时见到苏佳明。 三重奏发现自己身处三角情境,让女孩的友谊接受考验并改变她们的命运。)

programme.title: I Did It My Way (我以自己的方式做了)
programme.desc: As the secretive, complex world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and top-secret sting operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia. (警方发动了一场冒险、绝密的刺杀行动, 以击垮亚洲最臭名昭著的毒枭之一。)

programme.title: Someone Like Me (像我这样的人)
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Moscow Mission ((警察学校7：进军莫斯科))
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the China-Russia Train Robbery where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead (故事的根据是1993年发生的一次真实事件,即中俄火车抢劫,一帮罪犯抢劫一帮罪犯抢劫,从跨境火车上偷盗现金和货物。 中国一名警察伪装成商人,领导逮捕罪犯的行动,但发现了更大的阴谋。)

programme.title: Hit N Fun ((临时决斗))
programme.desc: Former Muay Thai legend Zhong Lei trains pro fighters despite his gyms struggles. When ad executive Lin learns her boyfriend is cheating with a champion boxer, she challenges her rival to a match and undergoes brutal training under Zhong. Through the grueling process, Lins quest for revenge transforms into a journey of self-discovery. (前泰国传奇人物Zhong Lei不顾体操斗争而训练亲战者。 当Lin执行官得知她的男朋友与拳击冠军作弊时,她挑战对手,在钟中接受残酷训练。 林斯通过痛苦的过程,复仇的追求转变成了自我发现之旅。)

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Two Con Men ((扭计祖宗陈梦吉))
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of Robin Hood meets The Sting. Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying whos done over 400 films as Tricky Ching, its the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. Its a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because peoples lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil. (两位康男是罗宾汉(Robin Hood)的一位神奇的扭曲、假罗马喜剧演员,他与《Sting. Starring Liang Tien 》 (The Sting. Starring Liang Tien ) 相遇,以明亮的陈氏和张英相遇,他拍了400多部电影,演的是《狡猾的清》,这是陈氏新手与富有经验的富富富男子之间的古老竞争。 陈氏的游戏是不能输的,因为人民(包括他自己)都活在善恶的平衡中。)

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance ((明月刀雪夜歼仇))
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: The Warlord ((投名状))
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool ((夺棍))
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown. (著名的功夫波尔师红,被一个恶棍绑架.他的门徒孟誓言要救他.在路上,孟遇到了一个贪但伟大的武术艺术家,同意加入他救援.尽管他们两个性格极其不同,但他们设法团结起来和恶棍在最后的对抗.)

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches (矛盾的喜剧)
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending. (两对情人意外失恋.男子在姐妹婚礼上伪装为女人,而情人则伪装为男人嫁给另一个女人.婚姻失调后,情人及其家人被带到法庭,县长设法找到幸福结局.)

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin ((洪熙官))
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolins Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hungs son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents kung fu styles. (王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王王)

programme.title: The Empress Dowager ((太后有喜))
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Condemned ((死囚大逃杀))
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Fengs innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra ((人蛇鼠))
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere. (惊人的的是,标题蛇不是恐怖的预言者,而是电影的英雄.这个美德的蛇嗅出炸弹,战斗帮派,战斗杀死婴儿的动物,甚至对付一个双重的女人.)

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu ((疯猴))
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult. (陈先生是一位受尊敬的子功夫大师,直到他被一个无情的恶棍入了架子和了,最终成为一个流浪艺术家.当陈在街上遇到一个年轻人,小子,他决定教他他的子功夫运动.)

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow ((徐老虎与白寡妇))
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal ((水晶人))
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader Yama Teng Wei-hao to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan Chen Hung and Pai Pan Hung Hsin-nan to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei Pai Piao... (王在地下死亡导致领导人怀疑一个有神秘力量的水晶肖像.)

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven ((七仙女))
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after? (玉帝的第七位女儿被逐出天堂,过着非常恶劣的凡人生活。她爱上了一个年轻村落的勇儿,他出卖自己为富人工作,以埋葬他的父亲。女神修女帮助勇偿还他的债务,以便爱鸟能够在一起。这是否将永远幸福地结束?)

programme.title: The Singing Killer ((小煞星))
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store. (易被他的前老板勒索,他威胁要揭露他的阴暗过去.)

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities ((港澳传奇))
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gamblers apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities. (李汉写了这部迷人而迷人的喜剧"两座城市的禁故事".这两个城市是澳门,爱情四人奏是性娱乐的道德不健康来源,香港,一个女人进入一个博家的公寓,发现四个链挂在天花板上,以帮助他做出恶意活动.)

programme.title: Martial Club ((武馆))
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liangs masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Gamblers Delight ((流氓千王))
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off! (杀手明星丹尼·李扮演一个需要成为英雄的男人的主角. 他撒谎,偷窃和欺骗自己运营一个豪华的场,)

programme.title: Sunset ((落日))
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers ((八国联军))
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies. (胡寻求报复他的父亲,他被白的子和他的帮派杀害.然而,他失败了他的尝试,被 Shi Yu,一个来自沙olin的年轻人拯救出来.他的父母也被同样的恶棍杀害.他们学习和掌握了先进的沙olin风格的功夫,然后领导胡和沙olin的同伙们去对抗敌人.)

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie ((花街时代))
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on. (年轻的梅丽在万市工作为酒吧女生,以谋生.当她在酒吧里遇到吉米时,她认为他是她的真正爱人,并疯狂地爱上他.当吉米必须离开时,梅丽很丧.直到她遇到三人团的老板,她终于找到了一个可以依靠的人.)

programme.title: The Flying Dagger ((飞刀又见飞刀))
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan heads son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear. (家族和绿龙族成为敌人,当时女杀害了族长的儿子,他是强奸犯和杀手.绿龙领袖用飞行的刀伤了家族的头,一名流浪剑手用自己的飞行刀技巧拯救了家庭.然而,他的忠诚和动机尚不清楚.)

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow ((倩女幽魂))
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches. (一位年轻学者宁在一个可怕的寺里度过了晚上.据说是鬼鬼的.他不相信谣言,但很快遇到了一个美丽的女鬼尼.尼被迫留在寺里,以诱惑年轻人,让一个强大的恶魔吃饭.知道尼是一个善良的鬼,宁决定帮助她摆脱恶魔的抓住.)

programme.title: The Singing Thief ((大盗歌王))
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him? (一个杰出珠宝盗窃者在夜总会上作为一名专业歌手转换了新页面.然而,不久之后发生了一系列抢劫事件,他再次成为嫌疑人.)

programme.title: The Blue and the Black ((罗密欧的蓝天))
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats ((南斗官三斗北少爷))
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the familys fortune.
